description: This file defines functions and types for detecting and managing browser executable paths, specifically for Chromium-based browsers, across different operating systems. It includes logic for identifying browser versions, paths, and types, and exports functions for platform-specific browser detection.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: execText
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments and returns the trimmed output or null on failure.

methods.name: inferKindFromIdentifier
methods.description: Infers browser kind from a given identifier string.

methods.name: inferKindFromExecutableName
methods.description: Infers browser kind from an executable filename.

methods.name: detectDefaultChromiumExecutable
methods.description: Detects the default Chromium executable based on platform.

methods.name: detectDefaultChromiumExecutableMac
methods.description: Detects Chromium executable on macOS.

methods.name: detectDefaultBrowserBundleIdMac
methods.description: Detects default browser bundle ID on macOS.

methods.name: detectDefaultChromiumExecutableLinux
methods.description: Detects Chromium executable on Linux.

methods.name: detectDefaultChromiumExecutableWindows
methods.description: Detects Chromium executable on Windows.

methods.name: findDesktopFilePath
methods.description: Finds desktop entry file path for a given desktop ID.

methods.name: readDesktopExecLine
methods.description: Reads the Exec line from a desktop entry file.

methods.name: extractExecutableFromExecLine
methods.description: Extracts the executable command from a desktop entry Exec line.

methods.name: splitExecLine
methods.description: Splits an Exec line into tokens, respecting quotes.

methods.name: resolveLinuxExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path of a Linux command.

methods.name: readWindowsProgId
methods.description: Reads the Windows ProgId for HTTP URL association.

methods.name: readWindowsCommandForProgId
methods.description: Reads the command associated with a Windows ProgId.

methods.name: expandWindowsEnvVars
methods.description: Expands environment variables in a Windows command string.

methods.name: extractWindowsExecutablePath
methods.description: Extracts the executable path from a Windows command string.

methods.name: findFirstExecutable
methods.description: Finds the first existing executable from a list of candidates.

methods.name: findFirstChromeExecutable
methods.description: Finds the first existing Chrome/Chromium executable from a list of paths.

methods.name: findChromeExecutableMac
methods.description: Returns a list of common Chrome/Chromium paths on macOS.

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableMac
methods.description: Returns paths for Google Chrome on macOS.

methods.name: findChromeExecutableLinux
methods.description: Returns a list of common Chrome/Chromium paths on Linux.

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableLinux
methods.description: Returns paths for Google Chrome on Linux.

methods.name: findChromeExecutableWindows
methods.description: Returns a list of potential Chrome/Chromium paths on Windows.

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableWindows
methods.description: Returns potential paths for Google Chrome on Windows.

methods.name: resolveGoogleChromeExecutableForPlatform
methods.description: Detects Chrome executable based on platform.

methods.name: readBrowserVersion
methods.description: Gets the version string of a browser executable.

methods.name: parseBrowserMajorVersion
methods.description: Parses the major version number from a version string.

methods.name: resolveBrowserExecutableForPlatform
methods.description: Resolves the browser executable path for a given platform and config.
